study type: Descriptive experimental study using animal models
outcome: Presence and distribution of apelin and apelin receptor in bitch placenta
cohort: Sixteen adult female half-breed bitches, divided into two groups based on stage of pregnancy (mid-gestation n=8, end gestation n=8).
finding: Apelin and its receptor were present and detected via immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR in all examined bitch placenta samples at both mid-gestation (30 days) and end gestation, with staining evident in cytotrophoblasts and epithelial cells of the maternal portion.
